read.thesis: Aluminium pricing and Middle East supply loss lift the smelter, but the refinery is still loss-making and 2026 smelter cash will not cover refinery FCF losses; no new capacity added.

utilisation.quote: additional production increases underway at Portland, São Luís, and Lista smelters

capex.peers_comment: 2.5 million tons of Middle East smelting capacity offline; no peer capacity addition discussed
capex.quote: We maintain our 2026 outlook for capital expenditures.

triggers.label: Middle East smelting capacity offline
triggers.quote: more than 2.5 million tons of annual smelting capacity and nearly 2 million tons of refining capacity are offline year to date

triggers.label: LME above $3,600/t
triggers.quote: recently exceeding $3,600 per metric ton, driven by tight inventories and supply disruptions

triggers.label: Refinery FCF losses exceed smelter cash
triggers.quote: within 2026, the smelter will not generate enough cash flow to cover the refinery’s free cash flow losses

triggers.label: Aluminum segment +$55M; Alumina -$15M
triggers.quote: Aluminum segment performance is expected to be favorable by $55 million

triggers.label: Warrick fourth line restart considered
triggers.quote: Capital required to restart the fourth line at Warrick smelter is approximately $100 million

guidance.quote: Aluminum segment performance is expected to be favorable by $55 million
Alumina segment performance is expected to be unfavorable by approximately $15 million
Interest expense will decrease slightly to $135 million with the redemption of our 2028 notes in May
our estimate for environmental and ARO payments has increased to approximately $360 million, up from $325 million

red_flags.label: Refinery losses; smelter cannot cover refinery FCF in 2026
red_flags.quote: within 2026, the smelter will not generate enough cash flow to cover the refinery’s free cash flow losses

red_flags.label: Negative FCF of $298M in Q1
red_flags.quote: Free cash flow was negative $298 million for the quarter

evasions.quote: we are weighing availability of short-term and long-term electricity
